Team Envy (formerly known as Team EnVyUs, often abbreviated to Envy, EnVy or nV) was an American esports organization founded in 2007 who used to be mainly known for their competitive Call of Duty background. Their original lineups were referred to as the "Boys in Blue".

  • February 1st - Team EnVyUs acquire Team LDLC.com's roster. [1]
  • July 20th - Team EnVyUs and Titan swap players, kennyS and apEX join the team, while shox and SmithZz leave. [2]
  • November 1st - Team EnVyUs win DreamHack Open Cluj-Napoca 2015 after beating Natus Vincere 2-0 in the finals.
  • January 10th - Maniac is officially announced as the new coach of Team EnVyUs. [3]
  • March 8th - DEVIL is acquired from Team LDLC.com White to replace kioShiMa in the active roster. The organization will honor kioShiMa's contract until a transfer to another organization is agreed upon, or he returns to the starting lineup [4]. The same day, kioShiMa issued a statement saying that communication within the team had been an issue, and that he felt he did not have the respect of the other members - leaving doubts as to whether he would ever return to the main roster [5]
  • April 10th - kioShiMa is bought out by FaZe Clan as a replacement for Maikelele. [6]
  • June 5th - Maniac leaves Team EnVyUs as he plans to go back to playing actively. [7]
  • June 13th - enkay J joins Team EnVyUs as an analyst.
  • October 5th - Team EnVyUs and Millenium swap DEVIL and SIXER. [8][9]
  • February 3rd - NBK-, kennyS, apEX and enkay J are acquired by G2 Esports to form the "French superteam". [10]
  • February 4th - To complete its roster, Team EnVyUs announce the arrivals of RpK, xms and devoduvek; maLeK joins as coach. [11]
  • February 8th - devoduvek moves to a backup position. [12]
  • February 21st - Team EnVyUs complete the signing of ScreaM. [13]
  • April 14th - devoduvek transfers to Misfits. [14]
  • February 3rd - kioShiMa returns while xms is benched. [15]
  • February 6th - hAdji is promoted to the main team from EnVyUs Academy replacing SIXER who is benched. [16]
  • February 13th - SIXER joins EnVyUs Academy. [17]
  • May 7th - Team Envy part ways with maLeK. [18]
  • June 20th - Team Envy part ways with all of their CS:GO rosters. [19]
  • September 27th - Team Envy sign the core of ex-Splyce, consisting of Drone, SEMPHIS, reltuC and coach Eley; as well as Nifty and jdm64. [20]
  • October 13th - Next stands down as manager. [21]
  • October 30th - Team Envy bench SEMPHIS. Pollo joins as a stand-in for the remainder of EPL Season 8 season. [22]
  • December - SEMPHIS's contract expires and he leaves Team Envy. [23]
  • December 31st - Team Envy acquire karrigan on loan from FaZe Clan and part ways with Pollo. [24]
  • January 30th - Team Envy announce that karrigan will stand in for them at IEM Sydney 2019: North America Qualifier. [25]
  • February 7th - karrigan announce the end of his loan with Team Envy. [26]
  • March 22nd - Team Envy add s0m, ANDROID, and FugLy. They release Drone and reltuC. [27]
  • June 2nd - Team Envy acquire Sonic from ATK, jdm64 is benched. [28]
  • July 1st - jdm64 announces his free agency and leaves Team Envy. [29]
  • September 12th - Sonic leaves Team Envy to join ATK. [30]
  • September 27th - Team Envy acquire ryann from Team Singularity. [31]
  • December 9th - Gen.G Esports acquire s0m from Team Envy. [32]
  • December 13th - Team Envy part ways with Tailored. [33]
  • December 14th - Team Envy part ways with Eley. [34]
  • January 1st - Team Envy bench ANDROID. [35]
  • January 15th - Team Envy bench FugLy. [36]
  • January 31st - Team Envy overhaul their roster with the additions of Calyx, MICHU, and moose; who is acquired from eUnited. Additionally, LEGIJA is signed as coach. [37]
  • February 25th - FugLy and ANDROID announce that their contracts have come to an end and they leave Team Envy. [38][39]
  • August 6th - Team Envy part ways with moose and ryann as LEGIJA transitions to a player position and kuben is signed as the team's coach and manager. [40][41]
  • September 10th - Team Envy acquire Thomas from Endpoint. [42]
  • January 11th - Team Envy transfer list their entire lineup and put their CS:GO division on hold. kuben is released. [43][44]
  • February 23rd - MICHU announces his free agency and leaves Team Envy. [45]
  • February 25th - Calyx announces his free agency and leaves Team Envy. [46]
  • February 26th - Thomas announces his free agency and leaves Team Envy. [47]
  • March 15th - LEGIJA announces his free agency and leaves Team Envy. [48]
